[Thinking]
**Factoring the quadratic equation**

I need to factor the equation 10x² + (260/√3)x - 1050. First, I factor out the 10, giving me 10(x² + (26/√3)x - 105). I calculate the discriminant, which I find to be 1936/3, leading to roots of x values at [-(26/√3) ± (44/√3)]/2. From this, I get roots of 3√3 and -35√3/3. I can express it as 10(x - 3√3)(x + 35/√3). After checking, it looks good!
[/Thinking]

\[
\boxed{10\left(x-3\sqrt{3}\right)\left(x+\frac{35}{\sqrt{3}}\right)}
\]
